import hashlib, json, re, subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from embed_optim.paper_layout import audit_paper_layout
from embed_optim.paper_audit import _abstract_word_budget, _active_manuscript_pending, _final_document_language_problems

story=Path('/root/embedding-optimizer-story-refactor')
archive=story/'reports/paper-review/dense-v3-retrieval-usefulness-v1'
experiment=Path('/root/embedding-optimizer-v3-experiment')
primary=Path('/root/embedding-optimizer-primary-v3')
changed={'paper/main.tex','paper/README.md','docs/naacl-dense-paper-plan.md','CURRENT_EXPERIMENT.md'}
def identity(path):
 raw=Path(path).read_bytes()
 return {'bytes':len(raw),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),'git_blob_sha1':hashlib.sha1(b'blob '+str(len(raw)).encode()+bytes([0])+raw).hexdigest()}
def check(path, expected):
 found=identity(path)
 assert all(found[k]==v for k,v in expected.items()),str(path)
 return found
before=json.loads((archive/'before-bindings.json').read_text())
assert len(before)==28
for relative, expected in before.items():
 check(archive/'before'/relative if relative in changed else story/relative,expected)
 assert relative not in changed or identity(story/relative)['sha256'] != expected['sha256']
old=story/'reports/engineering-archive/dense-v3-first-complete-evaluations-v1'
check(old/'verification.json',{'sha256':'8d9b100f00ad0d972aaa2e1a6eb3d44f926e4faca89ffab62c2067c4836c1b2b'})
previous=json.loads((old/'verification.json').read_text())
for name,expected in previous['archive_files'].items():check(old/name,expected)
for name,expected in previous['live_files'].items():
 check(archive/'before'/name if name in changed else story/name,expected)
check(story/'AGENTS.md',{'sha256':'2ea0ac433747a4406823013f36701f49fb8cd806a5c01bdbad73c88ad93b6946'})
check(primary/'source-assembly.json',{'sha256':'e603ef175c0f691a1dd83c4d8b474d90da2fc67c8c65f5a77f3c3180e78332b8'})
assembly=json.loads((primary/'source-assembly.json').read_text())
assert len(assembly['files'])==56
for root in (primary,experiment/'launch/source-snapshot'):
 for name,item in assembly['files'].items():check(root/name,item['identity'])
freeze={
 'evaluation-handoff/dispatch.py':'5b8a89bed5e0eaa02a12585ee3f6c883ca3e162b550898d68322321ee41d8427',
 'evaluation-handoff/authorization.json':'2351e225387f42fe607d7e002a0717de79a78cba9f3c93f66652510083f0be7c',
 'validation-handoff/validation.py':'d2fc55c67670ea5b42cacb055f48379ef278a465ce86d95808231ab86049d913',
 'validation-handoff/authorization.json':'6a8dcdd579bd6c2f6ea82e3f4cd808f88e92e9a28b9e97f41ffa6447eb0e1f6f',
 'functional-dimensions/dispatch.py':'3b02f1d8486f3c2b41d0403cbf291580d0ca32868b8b29cb05514a22770257f5',
 'functional-dimensions/authorization.json':'d72527595e2c963eae7fd46b0a1de2bd83d1ea15a863ae467a1065cfc5b2f336'}
for name,sha in freeze.items():check(experiment/'launch'/name,{'sha256':sha})
for name in ('main.pdf','main.log','main.aux'):
 assert (archive/'draft'/name).read_bytes()==(story/'paper/build'/name).read_bytes()
assert (archive/'draft/main.tex').read_bytes()==(story/'paper/main.tex').read_bytes()
layout=audit_paper_layout(story/'paper')
assert layout['main_end_page']==6
abstract=_abstract_word_budget(story)
pending=_active_manuscript_pending(story)
language=_final_document_language_problems(story)
assert abstract['complete'] and abstract['maximum_words_conservative']==173
assert [r['markers'] for r in pending]==[5,4,3]
assert language==[]
assert json.loads((archive/'draft-checks.json').read_text())=={'abstract':abstract,'pending':pending,'document_language_problems':language}
log=(story/'paper/build/main.log').read_text()
assert 'Overfull' not in log
assert not re.search(r'LaTeX Warning:.*(?:undefined|Citation|Reference)|There were undefined references',log)
fonts=subprocess.run(['pdffonts',str(story/'paper/build/main.pdf')],check=True,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout
font_rows=fonts.splitlines()[2:]
assert font_rows and all(row.split()[-5]=='yes' for row in font_rows)
assert 'Type 3' not in fonts
info=subprocess.run(['pdfinfo',str(story/'paper/build/main.pdf')],check=True,text=True,capture_output=True).stdout
pages=int(re.search(r'^Pages:\s+(\d+)',info,re.M).group(1))
assert pages==11
main=(story/'paper/main.tex').read_text()
old_main=(archive/'before/paper/main.tex').read_text()
input_pattern=r'\\(?:input|include)\{([^}]+)\}'
assert re.findall(input_pattern,main)==re.findall(input_pattern,old_main)==['results','generated/optimizer-primary','generated/dimension-utilization','generated/state-operator-factorial']
active_text=main+'\n'+'\n'.join((story/f'paper/generated/{name}.tex').read_text() for name in ('optimizer-primary','dimension-utilization','state-operator-factorial'))
for macro in ('DiscoveryHeadline','CommonStateHeadline','RepresentationHeadline','InterventionHeadline','ConfirmationHeadline','ResultConclusion'):
 assert not re.search(r'\\'+macro+r'\b',active_text),macro
subprocess.run(['git','-C',str(story),'diff','--check','--',*sorted(changed)],check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
checked_links=0
pending_self_links=0
for p in [archive/'README.md',story/'CURRENT_EXPERIMENT.md',story/'paper/README.md',story/'docs/naacl-dense-paper-plan.md']:
 for target in re.findall(r'\[[^\]]+\]\(([^)]+)\)',p.read_text()):
  target=target.split('#',1)[0].strip('<>')
  if not target or '://' in target:continue
  destination=(p.parent/target).resolve()
  if destination==archive/'verification.json':
   pending_self_links+=1
   continue
  assert destination.exists(),(str(p),target)
  checked_links+=1
source_refs=['src/embed_optim/dimension_utilization.py','src/embed_optim/primary_geometry_kernels.py','src/embed_optim/primary_exact_geometry_kernels.py','src/embed_optim/paper_audit.py','src/embed_optim/paper_layout.py']
result={'scope':'draft_retrieval_usefulness_prose_and_definition_review','observed_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'passed':True,
 'before_bindings_verified':len(before),'unchanged_before_bound_files':len(before)-len(changed),'changed_authorial_files':sorted(changed),
 'previous_archive_files_preserved':len(previous['archive_files']),'previous_live_bindings_preserved_or_routed':len(previous['live_files']),
 'primary_source_roots_verified':2,'primary_source_files_per_root':56,'frozen_dispatch_authorization_files_unchanged':6,
 'layout':layout,'abstract':abstract,'pending':pending,'document_language_problems':language,'pdf_pages':pages,'embedded_fonts':len(font_rows),'type_3_fonts':0,'overfull_boxes':0,'unresolved_reference_or_citation_warnings':0,
 'active_include_topology_unchanged':True,'legacy_result_headlines_not_invoked':True,'local_links_verified':checked_links,'verification_self_link_to_check_after_write':pending_self_links,
 'method_sources_reviewed':{name:identity(story/name) for name in source_refs},
 'actual_new_numerical_experiments':0,'remote_write':False,'source_release':False,'scientific_completion':False,'whole_goal_complete':False,
 'archive_files':{str(p.relative_to(archive)):identity(p) for p in sorted(archive.rglob('*')) if p.is_file() and p.name!='verification.json'},
 'live_files':{name:identity(story/name) for name in sorted(changed)}}
print(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True))
